summary: Built both milestones. M1: the flood live loop (floods/live.py) runs as a second asyncio task in the API lifespan (off with FIRE3D_FLOODS=0; a flood failure never reaches the fire loop), rebuilds the flood list every 15 min, spends at most 20 upstream requests a cycle on a background prefetch (product-text H-VTEC, zone outlines, member gauge series; NWS calls on NWS_LIMITER), appends new NWS product versions and gauge readings to ready bundles (every version kept, manifest.refreshed_ms), queues refresh jobs when NASA has a newer satellite pass or NWS a new forecast-map time, and auto-builds the 4 most severe floods once. /api/floods/status answers from the loop (counts null when the lists fail). CLI catalog --hazard flood and build-flood; check_bundle --hazard flood; SPEC 8.9. M2 (cut line, U1 (a)): past floods (floods/history.py). A bulk IEM route with H-VTEC severity, damage tags and emergencies exists (watchwarn.py CSV with follow-up statements + sbw_interval polygons), so the year lists follow PAST_RULE (moderate_or_worse), not the fallback; built once per year in the background (2025: 1,976 floods from 24 IEM + 5 map requests in 23 s; 2026: 2,108), cached for good for 2025, ids from the registry so live floods keep their ids; the detail chain's year step; archived NWS products and USGS readings with today's thresholds at past times. Gates green: backend 1383 passed, 0 skipped; web typecheck, lint 55 warnings (all src/scene), 1706 tests passed, build.

known_issues: Refresh jobs re-run the whole flood build (build.py is not this role's file); terrain comes from the HTTP cache, so a refresh takes 3-49 s, and built_ms changes (the web reloads the bundle).
Prepare 3D data for a past (year-list) flood answers 404: build.gate uses catalog.resolve, which has no year step, and the build has no past-time mode (deviation 6; for the integration).
Past years list one river flood per gauge episode: a long river flood can appear as several entries numbered by name ('Clackamas River flood (OR)', '(OR, 2)').
A past reading's category is 'unknown' (NWS's category of a past reading is not kept; Fire-3d does not infer it).
Some NWS gauges have no USGS site in NWPS (e.g. Mississippi River at Hickman, HKMK2): no past readings, caveat NO_USGS_SITE.
The year lists are about 3 MB of JSON each (gzip about 0.4 MB); the web renders about 2,000 markers per year.
The new backend strings live in floods/history.py (copy.py is not this role's file); the integration may move them and add them to CONTRACT 16.14.
The appended warnings.json / gauges.json reach an open Forensic view only after a reload (the web keys bundle files by built_ms; refreshed_ms is there for it).
The EARTHDATA_TOKEN path is still tested only with a fake token and a mock transport (not this role's code).
Two pre-brief-5 bundles in data/floods (Grand River, Peace River) fail check_bundle's credit check until rebuilt; the live loop's refresh rebuilt them in the scratch copy (0 problems).
